kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

lines.say: Storm going on in your life tonight? Hear this.
lines.big: Storm going on in your life tonight

lines.say: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still. Psalm one seven, verse twenty nine.
lines.big: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

lines.say: He can calm the storm, or calm you in the middle of it.
lines.big: He can calm the storm, or calm you in the middle of it.

lines.say: Lord, make the storm a calm tonight. Give me peace. In Jesus' name, amen.
